change.scope: EVALUATION POPULATION ONLY for the four props families, plus in-train re-selection of the ONE population-sensitive fitted parameter (targetShareDeflation gamma — its 0.90 value was selected against the absent-as-zero population and partly compensated for it). Model code, shares, rates, volumes, dispersion, integrated totals: unchanged.
change.gammaReselection: same frozen grid [1.00, 0.98, 0.96, 0.94, 0.92, 0.90], same criterion (min summed receiving-family walk-forward ECE), scored on season-2024 under participation-true conditioning. Tie -> 1.00.
change.measurementBeforeRegistration: A participation-true measurement run at the CURRENT gamma was taken before this registration (recorded in the annex); it motivated the re-selection and means 2025 outcomes under this conditioning have been seen once. This registration freezes the decision rule BEFORE the re-selected configuration is evaluated; the reused-season caveat applies at full strength and the 2026 forward record decides.

bars: The evaluator's standard promotion gates, unchanged: beats rolling4 AND shareVol on identical conditioned points, coverage in [0.72, 0.88], ece <= 0.05, n >= 300 -> PUBLIC_ELIGIBLE; (beats either) AND coverage in [0.68, 0.92] -> SHADOW_ELIGIBLE; else RESEARCH_ONLY.
decisionRule: The re-receipt under participation-true conditioning (with the in-train re-selected gamma) BECOMES the champion receipt. Promotion states land wherever the bars put them, and publication follows the receipts — including withdrawing a currently published family or promoting a currently withheld one. No state is pinned in advance.
publicationConsequences: Boards regenerate through the production-owned pipeline on the next natural run; withheld families name their exact failed bars as always; the register records any publication change before first kickoff.
notes: Registered before the re-selected configuration was evaluated; commit order is the proof.
